# Maintenance mode (community, Node only)

One switch for the whole deployment (`settingsScope: system`). While it is on:

- visitors and non-admins get a maintenance page (`render.before` answers with `ctx.respond`, marked `noindex`)
- plugin operations answer 503 for non-admins (`rest.before.request`)
- scheduled jobs are skipped when **Pause scheduled jobs** is on (`schedule.before.run`)

Admins keep seeing and doing everything.

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| hook | `rest.before.request` | a request to a plugin or core route is about to reach its handler | Refuses API requests from everyone but admins with a 503 while maintenance mode is on, so admins keep working and everyone else waits. |
| hook | `render.before` | a page is about to be rendered (live request or static publish) | Answers dynamic page views from non-admins with a short noindex maintenance page showing the message setting, while maintenance mode is on. |
| hook | `schedule.before.run` | a scheduled job is about to run (from `hax plugin schedule run` or the timer plugin) | Holds back every scheduled job while maintenance mode is on and pauseJobs is set. |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs`.
